carla_cs: Quick heads-up 3:00 onboarding for OrbitIQ. They want a tiny field kit: 1) one-page PM checklist (non-technical) and 2) a paste-ready infra snippet for engineers on caching/batching/streaming. Objective: reduce first-week renewal risk.

ben_csm: I'll draft the PM one-pager. Can we include three preset profiles (safe / balanced / performance) with copyable numbers so PMs can pick quickly?

ryan_sre: Yes. Suggested engineer defaults (copy/paste): Safe: ttl=30s, max_batch_gpu=8, max_batch_cpu=4. Balanced: ttl=150s, max_batch_gpu=16, max_batch_cpu=6. Performance: ttl=600s, max_batch_gpu=32, max_batch_cpu=8. Streaming: chunk_tokens=128, stream_window_ms=80. KV cache: 64MB (small) / 128MB (mid). Warm pools for first 48h.

ryan_sre: Paste-ready JSON block for engineers (single-line friendly): {"cache_strategy":"prefix","ttl_seconds":"150","kv_mb":"128","batch_gpu":"16","batch_cpu":"6","batch_timeout_ms":"20","stream_chunk_tokens":"128","stream_window_ms":"80","p95_target_ms":"250","fallback_sync_after_ms":"300"}

emily_support: For PM copy translate numbers to plain choices: Safe = low-risk (low TTL, small batches); Balanced = tradeoff; Performance = high throughput (must prime caches). Add quick checklist: Day0 smoke, Day1 prime, Day3 telemetry review, Day7 renewal checkpoint.

carla_cs: Add concrete priming advice: prefill top 50 prompt keys, run 8 representative queries per heavy user, enable warm pool for 48h. Also include escalation triggers: p95 > 350ms on Day3 or cache_hit% < 25%.

ben_csm: Draft PM one-pager text (short): 1) Day0 Smoke: run 5 sample prompts end-to-end; confirm partial tokens stream. 2) Day1 Prime: send 8 queries per top user to populate cache. 3) Day3 Telemetry: check p95 & cache hit% (target >35%). 4) Day7 Renewal Signal: if p95 >350ms or cache_hit <25%, contact CSM for tuning.

ryan_sre: Quick triage commands to include for engineers (single-line examples): redwoodctl metrics query --customer orbitiq --metric cache_hit_ratio --window 24h; redwoodctl metrics query --customer orbitiq --metric p95_latency,error_rate --window 24h; redwoodctl logs tail --customer orbitiq --filter "stream_error" --since 1h

emily_support: Ops playbook bullets: If latency spikes -> switch profile to Safe, halve batch sizes, lower batch_timeout_ms; If cache_hit low -> run prefill for top keys; If streaming gaps -> reduce stream_chunk_tokens to 64 and raise stream_window_ms. Escalation path: CSM -> Support on-call -> SRE.

carla_cs: Feedback capture: tiny Day7 survey for PMs to send their engineers: Q1) Responses meet expectations? (yes/no + note) Q2) Any responses >500ms? (yes/no + example) Q3) Any streaming artifacts? (yes/no). We'll collect replies in the CS dashboard.

ben_csm: Owners: Ben = PM one-pager + email template, Ryan = infra snippet + triage commands, Emily = run Day0 smoke and Day3 check-ins. bot-prefill will schedule a prefill job for top keys.

bot-prefill: scheduled job "prefill-top-keys" for orbitiq at 2025-06-22T09:00:00Z - status: queued :gear:

emily_support: I'll run Day0 smoke at 14:00 PT and post results here. Saving thread and will upload docs to customer folder. If anyone has edge-case notes (very short prompts, chatty streaming UI), drop them before EOD. :white_check_mark:
